title: Lead Engineer - Converions/Migration
description:
**Skills**

SQL Server, ETL/Data Migration, Azure Data Factory (ADF)

**Years**

6 to 9 years

**Location**

Kochi/Trivandrum

**Job Role**

Lead Engineer - Conversion/Migration to work under the direction of the Data Conversion Architect, driving the hands-on design, build, and execution of data conversion and migration pipelines for enterprise client engagements.

**JD/Responsibilities**

•Strong hands-on expertise in SQL Server (T-SQL) and relational database design, with solid experience in data migration and conversion projects.

•Design and build ETL/ELT pipelines to convert data between source and target systems, following the mapping and transformation logic defined by the Architect.

•Good working knowledge of data mapping, source-to-target transformation logic, and reconciliation techniques for large datasets.

•Hands-on experience writing and optimizing SQL Server stored procedures, indexes, and queries for high-volume batch processing.

•Proficiency with ETL tooling such as SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent, along with scripting (PowerShell/Python) for data validation and automation.

•Good understanding of data quality, de-duplication, cleansing, and validation techniques.

•Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Azure SQL, Azure Synapse, or AWS RDS/Redshift) and hybrid on-prem-to-cloud migration patterns.

•Awareness of data security and compliance considerations during migration, including encryption at rest/in transit and access controls.

•Ability to execute rollback, dry-run, and phased/parallel-run cutover activities under the guidance of the Architect.

•Ability to maintain data lineage, mapping documentation, and audit trails for validation and sign-off purposes.

•Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with experience resolving issues in large batch conversion jobs.

7–10 Years

**Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) Lead**
to lead enterprise integration initiatives across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid application landscapes.
  
  
This role is responsible for defining integration strategy, designing scalable integration architectures, establishing governance standards, and leading teams responsible for implementing secure and high-performing integrations using
**Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)**
and related enterprise integration technologies.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Oracle Integration Cloud, API-led integration, enterprise application connectivity, process automation, and integration architecture. You will work closely with Architects, Business Analysts, Salesforce Teams, ERP Teams, HR Technology Teams, and Business Stakeholders to deliver seamless connectivity between Oracle Cloud Applications, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Microsoft platforms, and other enterprise systems.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for professionals who enjoy solving complex integration challenges while supporting large-scale enterprise modernization and digital transformation programs.

**Integration Leadership & Architecture**

* Design scalable, secure, and resilient integration solutions supporting cloud-to-cloud, cloud-to-on-premises, and hybrid ecosystems.

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of integration solutions using:

+ Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)

+ Process Automation

+ File-Based Integrations
+ Event-Driven Integrations

* Ensure delivery of scalable, maintainable, and reusable integration solutions.

**Enterprise Application Integrations**

* Lead integrations involving:

+ Oracle ERP Cloud
+ Oracle HCM Cloud
+ Oracle EPM
+ Salesforce
+ ServiceNow
+ Workday
+ SAP
+ Microsoft Platforms
+ Third-Party SaaS Applications

* Ensure seamless data synchronization, workflow orchestration, and process automation across enterprise systems.
* Support enterprise-wide business processes spanning finance, HR, service management, customer operations, and shared services.

**API Management & Security**

* Design and manage APIs using Oracle Integration Cloud capabilities.
* Implement API governance, lifecycle management, and security standards.
* Support authentication and security frameworks including:

+ OAuth 2.0
+ JWT
+ SSL/TLS
+ API Security Policies
+ Identity and Access Management Controls

* Ensure compliance with enterprise security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

**Operational Excellence & Delivery Governance**

* Monitor and optimize integration performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex integration issues.
* Establish proactive monitoring, alerting, and support mechanisms.
* Support release management, production deployments, upgrades, and platform maintenance activities.
* Manage integration risks, dependencies, and operational challenges.
* Ensure timely and high-quality delivery across integration workstreams.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Lead and mentor Integration Developers and technical teams.
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture compliance assessments.
* Support technical capability development, certification initiatives, and knowledge sharing.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Act as the primary escalation point for integration-related technical issues.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7–10 years of overall IT experience.
* Minimum 5+ years of enterprise integration experience.
* Minimum 3+ years of hands-on Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) experience.
* Experience leading enterprise integration projects and technical teams.
* Proven track record delivering large-scale integration solutions in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong stakeholder management, leadership, and communication skills.

**Oracle Technologies**

**Integration Technologies**

* REST APIs
* SOAP Services
* Web Services
* XML
* JSON
* XSLT

* File-Based Integrations

**Enterprise Integration Expertise**

* Integration Architecture

* API Management

**Security Expertise**

* OAuth 2.0

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting AI-enabled business workflows and enterprise orchestration solutions.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- Saviynt Staff**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Ability to architect IGA solutions using Saviynt
* Ability to drive IGA projects including project management, team management, client management.
* Should have experience in implementing at least one complete IAM SDLC engagements projects. This must include activities such as requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and application support
* Engineer, develop and maintain enterprise IAM solutions using Saviynt IGA tool
* Develop and Build new application Integration, Account and Entitlement Connectors and perform periodic certification reviews in the Saviynt Platform.
* Experience in development phase for Saviynt components - Build Warehouse, Access Request System (ARS), Rule Management, User Provisioning, Access Certification, Identity analytics, Segregation of Duties
* Good knowledge in the configuring of workflows in Saviynt IGA tool. Good knowledge of configuring birthright rules for the user onboarding workflows. Have involved in creation of XML jobs in Saviynt IGA tool.
* Experience in implementation process, built and deployment in Saviynt process.
* Should have good understanding of RDMS and SQL queries.
* Professional IT certifications are a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
Position Title : Analyst, Data Management, Cochin, India

Department : Data Management and Analysis, Global Marketing,

**Job Purpose:**

The primary purpose of this position is to manage, maintain, and analyze business data to support sales, marketing, and business operations. The role is responsible for ensuring high data quality, maintaining master data, developing reports and dashboards, supporting business users, and providing analytical insights that enable effective business decision-making and continuous process improvement.

**Principal Accountabilities**

**Key Challenges**

Skills, Know How and Experience

* Manage and maintain customer, product, sales and other business master data across multiple systems.
* Develop and maintain standard and ad hoc reports, dashboards and business analysis.
* Perform data validation, cleansing and quality checks.
* Research and resolve data-related issues and user queries.
* Support business initiatives, system enhancements and process improvements.
* Collaborate with cross-functional and global teams.
* Identify opportunities for reporting automation and process optimization.
* Monitor key business metrics and prepare management reports.

1. Position Dimensions:

* Member of the Data Management and Analytics Team within Global Marketing
* Understanding business processes and data relationships.
* Managing large datasets across multiple systems.
* Ensuring data quality and integrity.
* Delivering timely and accurate reports.
* Supporting diverse stakeholders with evolving business needs.
* Driving continuous improvement through automation.

Skills/Know How

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Attention to detail with a focus on data quality.
* Comfortable working across multiple business applications and large datasets.
* Ability to learn new systems and leverage AI-powered productivity tools.
* Proactive, adaptable and self-driven.
* Able to take ownership and use initiative, meet deadlines and work in a fast-paced environment.

Experience

* 0–1 years of experience in Data Management, Business Reporting, or related fields. Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Statistics, or related discipline.
  **BTECH+MBA candidate preference**
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Data Analytics, Operations or Systems.
* Strong hands-on experience in MS Excel and MS PowerPoint.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot and other AI productivity tools is preferred.
* Knowledge of Power BI, CRM tools, and Business Intelligence tools will be an added advantage.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics - Semantic BI Engineer – Senior**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY's Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalise on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client's decision-making.
  
  
**Role : Semantic BI Engineer**
**Experience Guide : 3-7 Years**
**Primary Skill Area :**
Semantic Analytics, Self-Service BI, Dashboards, AI-Enabled Insights & Decision Intelligence
  
  
**The opportunity**
Design, build and advise on enterprise BI and semantic analytics solutions that convert trusted data into actionable business insights. This role is not limited to dashboard development; the candidate must be able to assess business needs, propose the right dashboarding or self-service reporting tools, design semantic data layers, build high-quality dashboards, and enable next-generation AI-assisted analytics experiences. The role combines analytics engineering, semantic layer design, dashboard architecture, BI strategy, data storytelling, data modelling, AI enablement and strong business analysis capability.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* BI Strategy, Tool Evaluation & Solution Advisory
* Assess business reporting, analytics and self-service consumption needs across user personas, maturity levels, governance requirements and operating constraints.
* Evaluate and recommend the right BI, dashboarding and self-service reporting tools based on scalability, semantic layer fit, governance, cost, user adoption, integration capability and AI-readiness.
* Shape enterprise BI and analytics roadmaps across Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst and other modern analytics platforms.
* Advise stakeholders on when to use operational reporting, executive dashboards, self-service analytics, semantic search, conversational BI, embedded analytics or AI-assisted insight discovery.
* Semantic Layer & Analytics Engineering
* Design semantic data layers that separate business logic from physical data structures and allow consistent consumption across dashboards, reporting tools, AI assistants and self-service analytics platforms.
* Define governed business metrics, KPIs, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, calculations, data definitions and reusable analytical entities.
* Develop analytics engineering assets using SQL, dbt-style transformation patterns, Fabric semantic models, Power BI datasets, lakehouse/warehouse tables and curated analytical data products.
* Align semantic models with business glossaries, metadata, lineage, data quality rules, access controls and enterprise governance standards.
* Dashboard Development, Architecture & Data Storytelling
* Design and develop high-quality dashboards, scorecards and analytical reports that support executive decisions, operational monitoring, root-cause analysis and business performance tracking.
* Apply dashboard design principles including KPI hierarchy, drill-through, guided navigation, narrative flow, visual consistency, usability, accessibility and performance optimisation.
* Build dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst or equivalent enterprise BI platforms.
* Move beyond visualisation by translating patterns, trends and exceptions into actionable business insights, recommendations and decision support.
* Data Modelling, Data Analysis & Insight Generation
* Apply strong data modelling skills including dimensional modelling, star schema design, semantic modelling, analytical data product modelling, metric modelling and data mart design.
* Perform deep data analysis using SQL, analytical thinking, data profiling, reconciliation, segmentation, trend analysis, variance analysis and root-cause investigation.
* Partner with business SMEs, data engineers, data architects and product owners to convert business questions into robust data models, analytical logic and reusable reporting assets.
* Ensure insights are grounded in trusted data, explainable logic, meaningful context and clear business interpretation.
* AI-Enabled Analytics & Next-Generation BI
* Understand where and how AI can improve analytics workflows, including natural language querying, automated insight generation, anomaly detection, narrative summaries, semantic search and guided analysis.
* Enable AI-assisted analytics using capabilities such as Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI where relevant.
* Design AI-ready semantic layers that provide business context, trusted metrics, governed definitions and explainability for conversational BI and agentic analytics use cases.
* Identify appropriate use cases for AI in BI while recognising where traditional dashboards, governed reports or human-led analysis remain more suitable.
* Governance, Adoption & Analytics Operating Model
* Define governance standards for dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, certified datasets, access controls, refresh schedules, lifecycle management and reporting asset ownership.
* Support integration with governance and catalogue platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Immuta or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Create templates, design standards, dashboard review checklists, documentation patterns and adoption playbooks for consistent analytics delivery.
* Enable business users through self-service analytics training, guardrails, metric definitions and trusted data consumption practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* BI and dashboarding - Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, executive dashboards, self-service reporting, embedded analytics.
* Semantic and analytics engineering - Semantic layers, Fabric Semantic Models, Power BI datasets, metrics layer, governed KPIs, SQL, dbt-style modelling, analytical data products, business glossary alignment.
* Data modelling - Dimensional modelling, star schema design, snowflake schema design, semantic modelling, metric modelling, data mart design, canonical/domain model awareness, data dictionary creation.
* Data analysis and insight generation - Advanced SQL, data profiling, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, variance analysis, segmentation, data storytelling, business analysis, actionable insight generation.
* AI and next-generation analytics - Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure OpenAI, conversational BI, semantic search, AI-assisted insights, agentic analytics.
* Governance and operations - Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Immuta, certified datasets, data lineage, access controls, dashboard governance, BI adoption, performance optimisation.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience guide: 3-7 years
* 3+ years of experience in BI, analytics engineering, data analysis, semantic modelling, data modelling or analytics architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience developing dashboards and semantic models, with the ability to advise on the right BI/self-service analytics tools for business needs.
* Preferred certifications: Power BI Data Analyst, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer, Tableau, Snowflake/Databricks analytics credentials, AI/GenAI foundations or cloud data certifications.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.
* This role is not a traditional BI Developer. It is a Semantic BI Engineer and analytics architect who defines how trusted data is modelled, consumed and converted into actionable insight through governed dashboards, self-service analytics and AI-enabled decision intelligence.

**What We Look For**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasises high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Performance monitoring & tuning, Problem analysis & resolution, and other activities required to maintain system integrity SAP administration on UNIX & Windows
* System /System copy
* ABAP + Java-dual stack
* Add-on and Support Pack application and troubleshooting
* Kernel Upgrade
* Client copies and export-import
* TMS administration and configuration and troubleshooting Transport errors
* SAP system monitoring and thorough analysis of issues
* SAP parameter change, operation mode setup, Logon group setup
* SAP Role based Authorization knowledge - Role creation and modification
* Spool administration and troubleshooting spool/printer issues
* OSS Note application
* Experience in Single -Sign On, Web Dispatcher
* Experience in working SAP on public cloud and private cloud.
* Experience in working with cloud service providers like AWS, Azure and GCP.
* SAP Solution Manager experience with basic and advanced configuration.
* Hands-on experience with SAP user provisioning, authorization troubleshooting, and role assignments.
* Basic knowledge of OS/DB migration processes.
* Familiarity with Web Dispatcher, Gateway, and SAP integration components.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Should have 4 to 7 years of experience in SAP Basis domain.
* Solid hands-on experience in SAP system administration, including installation, configuration, upgrades, and performance optimization.
* Should understand SAP architecture, transport management, kernel updates, and system refresh processes.
* Proficient in administering SAP HANA (monitoring, tuning, backup/recoveries, basic troubleshooting).
* Experience supporting landscapes like S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, PO/PI, Fiori, Solution Manager, etc.
* Strong SAP BTP knowledge, including key services, integration patterns, and administration fundamentals.
* Strong working experience with RISE with SAP environments and operational activities.
* Strong documentation skills for system delivery, ensuring clear, structured, and audit‑ready technical documentation.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with clients and stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Solution Manager features such as CHARM, EWA, and monitoring.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Practical experience managing SAP workloads on Azure or AWS (VMs, storage classes, networking, monitoring).
* Exposure to SAP Cloud ALM (CALM) for monitoring, change control, and operations.
* Exposure to SAP Data Archiving with OpenText

**Certifications:**

* SAP Technology Associate certifications (SAP Basis or HANA).
* SAP Cloud Certifications (RISE, BTP, HANA Cloud, etc.).
* Cloud certification (AWS, Azure and GCP).
* Exposure to enterprise transformation tools such as Signavio and LeanIX for process modeling, architecture governance, and landscape documentation.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**DC Exit & Cloud Migration Consultant - Senior**
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking a highly skilled DC Exit & Cloud Migration Senior Consultant with 6+ years of strong experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure modernization, datacenter transformation, and cloud migration initiatives across enterprise environments. The role focuses on planning, assessing, designing, and executing datacenter exit and cloud migration programs to accelerate application modernization, infrastructure optimization, operational resilience, and cloud adoption for enterprise clients.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on cloud engineering expertise combined with consulting experience and the ability to drive migration assessments, transformation roadmaps, proof-of-concepts, and migration execution across complex hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Assess, design, and execute datacenter exit and cloud migration strategies for enterprise applications, infrastructure, databases, and platforms.
* Perform application portfolio assessments and define migration approaches including Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retain, Retire, and Replace strategies.
* Develop cloud migration roadmaps, transformation plans, landing zones, and migration wave planning for enterprise clients.
* Strong competency in cloud engineering across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, including infrastructure provisioning, modernization, and workload migration.
* Design and implement cloud-native architectures leveraging compute, storage, networking, security, containers, and platform services.
* Support migration discovery, dependency mapping, infrastructure assessment, capacity planning, and migration readiness activities.
* Develop automation solutions using Terraform, Python, PowerShell, Shell scripting, and Infrastructure as Code principles to accelerate migration programs.
* Execute application, server, database, storage, and platform migrations while ensuring business continuity and operational stability.
* Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, networking, and operations teams to align migration initiatives with enterprise governance standards.
* Support cloud modernization initiatives involving containers, Kubernetes, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and Platform Engineering practices.
* Design and execute migration proof-of-concepts (PoCs), pilot migrations, validation activities, and cloud transformation assessments.
* Develop migration dashboards, reporting frameworks, business cases, and executive presentations to support client engagements.
* Provide technical advisory support on cloud adoption, application modernization, landing zone architecture, cloud governance, and migration best practices.
* Support cloud cost optimization, operational readiness, resiliency planning, and post-migration stabilization activities.

**Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Transformation, Datacenter Migration, Cloud Migration, and Technology Delivery.
* Strong understanding of datacenter exit strategies, cloud migration methodologies, and application modernization principles.
* Experience designing and executing migrations to Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, networking, storage, security, and identity management.
* Experience with virtualization platforms including VMware and hybrid cloud environments.
* Knowledge of migration assessment, dependency mapping, migration planning, and workload transformation frameworks.
* Experience working with Infrastructure as Code, automation frameworks, and cloud engineering practices.
* Experience working in client-facing consulting, advisory, or cloud transformation engagements.
* Strong problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Technical Expertise:**

* Strong expertise in cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience with cloud migration services including Azure Migrate, AWS Migration Hub, CloudEndure, Azure Site Recovery, AWS Application Migration Service (MGN), and related migration tools.
* Strong competency in infrastructure assessment, dependency mapping, migration planning, and workload transformation methodologies.
* Hands-on experience with Python, PowerShell, Shell Scripting, and Infrastructure Automation.
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, ARM Templates, Bicep, CloudFormation, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of compute, storage, networking, identity, security, backup, and disaster recovery services across cloud platforms.
* Experience with virtualization and hybrid cloud technologies including VMware, Hyper-V, and container-based platforms.
* Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
* Strong competency in DevOps and CI/CD tools including Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Git, and automation frameworks.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases including SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB, and Cosmos DB.
* Understanding of cloud governance, landing zones, operational readiness, observability, and cloud security best practices.
* Experience supporting application modernization, platform transformation, and cloud-native adoption initiatives.
* Familiarity with monitoring and observability platforms such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk, and Grafana.

title: Senior OT & IT Data Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior OT/IT Data Specialist will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform. This role bridges industrial automation, OT/IT networking, industrial data engineering, and modern software platforms. The successful candidate will support integration of shop-floor equipment and OT systems with edge, enterprise IT, and cloud services while ensuring industrial data is secure, reliable, well-governed, and fit for downstream applications.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on technical role that combines architecture support, technical delivery, platform troubleshooting, vendor coordination, stakeholder collaboration, data governance, and operational support across manufacturing locations. The role will work closely with architects, engineers, lifecycle teams, system integrators, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable smart factory solutions and support future digital manufacturing initiatives.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Participate in site-level architecture design activities across manufacturing locations and support implementation of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Data Backbone infrastructure, including Kubernetes/OpenShift-based edge deployments.
* Integrate industrial equipment, PLCs, and OT systems using industrial protocols such as Siemens S7, OPC UA, MQTT, and similar connectivity technologies.
* Troubleshoot OT/IT networking issues including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and edge-to-cloud connectivity.
* Build, support, and maintain industrial data pipelines, messaging solutions, and integration architectures using technologies such as Litmus, MQTT, and OPC UA.
* Develop and maintain industrial data models to contextualize machine, asset, and time-series data for downstream applications and analytics.
* Perform data validation and troubleshooting across the complete machine-to-cloud data flow, including equipment, network, edge platform, data pipeline, and database/cloud environments to ensure data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
* Support technical acceptance testing of vendor solutions following deployment and contribute to Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) activities.
* Support IT/OT risk assessments related to the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform and connected manufacturing systems.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of data governance standards, documentation, tag naming conventions, and tag enablement processes.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including system designs, technical procedures, configuration guides, governance documentation, and operational support materials.
* Collaborate closely with architects, lifecycle teams, software developers, data engineers, system integrators, vendors, and manufacturing stakeholders to support successful project delivery.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, troubleshooting activities, and continuous improvement initiatives for industrial data platforms and connected systems.
* Transfer technical knowledge to lifecycle teams, contractors, vendors, developers, and support personnel to ensure sustainable long-term platform ownership.
* Take ownership of assigned technical activities and proactively drive issues to resolution while effectively communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering governance practices.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Data Science, Automation, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience supporting one or more of the following areas:
* OT/IT convergence
* Industrial automation
* IIoT and Smart Factory platforms
* Industrial data engineering
* Industrial IT
* Platform engineering
* Systems engineering
* Strong experience with industrial protocols and connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, Siemens S7, or equivalent industrial communication protocols.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Experience designing, implementing, or supporting industrial data pipelines, messaging platforms, and integration architectures.
* Experience working with industrial Historians, time-series databases, or similar industrial data platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or other containerized deployment technologies.
* Experience with Litmus or equivalent industrial edge platforms is preferred.
* Experience with AVEVA Historian, QuestDB, PI System, Ignition Historian, or equivalent Historian/time-series database platforms is desirable.
* Experience with tag enablement, Historian/SCADA tag scaling, and configuration activities is preferred.
* Experience with Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures and industrial data contextualization is desirable.
* Experience working in multi-site manufacturing, industrial, process industry, energy, oil and gas, utilities, or brownfield operational environments is advantageous.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity practices and standards such as IEC 62443.
* Experience supporting production platforms, operational support teams, and lifecycle management activities.
* Experience collaborating with external technology vendors, system integrators, and third-party service providers.
* Ability to develop and maintain solutions using Python, Go, TypeScript, Node-RED, or similar technologies.
* Experience with modern software development and operational practices including SLAs, change management, incident management, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across OT, IT, engineering, and business teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows initiative, adaptability, and a proactive attitude while working across organizational and geographical boundaries.
* Produces accurate, maintainable, and well-documented technical solutions while maintaining high standards of quality and reliability.
* Comfortable working in a global environment with stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark and manufacturing sites as required.

title: Engineering Systems Support Analyst
description:

Responsibilities include application support, data analysis, SQL reporting, troubleshooting, documentation, process improvement, and collaboration with engineering, IT, and business stakeholders.

Candidates should enjoy problem solving, working with data, learning new technologies, and supporting enterprise applications within an engineering and manufacturing environment. As experience grows, the role will progress toward ownership of engineering systems, business processes, and system improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide technical support for PLM systems and associated engineering applications across multiple business units and engineering disciplines.

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate and resolve technical and data\-related issues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, business, and IT teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows curiosity and initiative by continuously learning new systems, technologies, and business processes.
* Communicates proactively, builds positive working relationships, and effectively collaborates with internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Produces accurate, well\-documented, and maintainable solutions while maintaining a high standard of quality.
* Approaches challenges with professionalism, persistence, and a customer\-focused mindset.

title: O9 Engineer
description:
Experience \- 5 plus years
   

  

 We are hiring an O9 Solutions Engineer to support and evolve the O9 platform for one of the largest retailers in the United States. O9 is the system of record for demand forecasting, supply planning, and allocation decisions across our brands, regions, and channels. This role owns the day\-to\-day health of the platform — triaging and resolving incidents, maintaining data integrity between O9 and upstream/downstream systems such as Oracle EBS, and partnering with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and Merchandising teams to keep the platform reliable, accurate, and easy to use across a global user base (US, UK, EMEA, and APAC).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as a primary point of support for O9 Supply Planning and Demand Planning modules, triaging incidents end\-to\-end from intake through root\-cause and resolution.
* Investigate and resolve data integrity issues between O9 and connected systems (Oracle EBS, RMA/returns feeds, buy\-plan and sourcing extracts), including mismatched quantities, missing style\-colors, and forecast data not flowing between planning modules.
* Diagnose and fix planning logic issues — unmet demand, incorrect season codes, planned orders not grouping correctly, buy dates shifting unexpectedly, and similar planning\-engine anomalies.
* Manage user access and provisioning (new hires, role changes, regional access, ownership transfers) and drive toward self\-service or bulk\-provisioning workflows to reduce manual ticket volume.
* Own incident and backlog hygiene: track SLAs, prioritize aging tickets, and ensure nothing sits unresolved for months without visibility to stakeholders.
* Partner with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and regional business teams (US, UK, China, Japan) to translate business\-reported issues into technical root causes.
* Build and maintain runbooks, root\-cause documentation, and knowledge base articles so common issues can be resolved consistently — not just by institutional memory.
* Support configuration changes, workflow updates, and enhancements within O9 as the retailer's planning processes evolve (new brands, new seasons, new regions).
* Participate in O9 platform upgrades, testing cycles, and post\-implementation review (PIR) processes for major changes.
* Escalate to and collaborate with O9 Solutions' vendor support team on platform\-level defects that require vendor engineering involvement.
* Skillset
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting or implementing O9\.
* Solid understanding of retail supply chain planning concepts: demand forecasting, supply/buy planning, allocation, assortment, and season/style\-color management.
* Experience integrating planning systems with ERP platforms, ideally Oracle EBS, including familiarity with common data reconciliation issues between planning and execution systems.
* Strong troubleshooting skills — comfortable reading data flows end\-to\-end to isolate whether an issue originates in source data, integration, or planning logic.
* Experience with incident management tools (ServiceNow or similar) and a track record of managing ticket queues, SLAs, and prioritization in a production support environment.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data investigation and validation.
* Excellent written communication skills — you'll be documenting root causes and explaining technical issues to non\-technical business stakeholders across time zones.
* Comfortable working with global, cross\-regional teams (US, EMEA, APAC) and adjusting communication style accordingly.
